alerts.title: US 50 Rock Scaling-149807
alerts.description: Between Red Creek Road and Elk Creek Road (15 to 16 miles west of the Gunnison area) from Mile Point 139 to Mile Point 140. Road closed due to rock fall mitigation. Starting October 19, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 22, 2026 at about 4:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 19, 7:00AM - October 22, 4:00PM Comment: ⚠️TRAVEL ALERT⚠️ | US 50 (Blue Mesa Reservoir) Traffic Holds 🚧7:00 a.m. to 4 p.m. 🚧| Monday, Oct. 19 - Thursday, Oct. 22 Expect daily 20-minute traffic holds on US 50 (Mile Points 139–140) while crews safely perform rock mitigation. Motorists should plan for anticipated traffic holds up to 20 minutes while crew perform necessary rockfall scaling. For safety, drivers are advised to stay on US 50 and remain inside their vehicles during holds. All work is weather-dependent and subject to change. 🌐More info: COtrip Planner App or COtrip.org

alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148526
alerts.description: Between Exit 129: Bair Ranch (6 miles west of the Dotsero area) and Exit 125: Hanging Lake (5 miles east of the No Name area) from Mile Point 126 to Mile Point 125. Right lane closed due to bridge construction. Starting October 20, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 20, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 20, 7:00AM - October 20, 7:00PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
